onboardingIllustration.wiredInto: src/welcome/welcome.html (inlined, not loaded as an external file, so it can use welcome.css's var(--card)/var(--border)/var(--primary)/var(--muted) and track light/dark mode automatically)
onboardingIllustration.dimensions: viewBox 0 0 440 176, scales to 100% width up to max-width: 440px (src/welcome/welcome.css .hero-illustration)
onboardingIllustration.ariaHidden: true — reinforces the existing step-by-step text on the Welcome screen rather than conveying new information, so it carries no alt text of its own
onboardingIllustration.generatedWith: local-designer skill: hand-authored SVG, no rasterization needed (renders natively and crisply in the extension UI, zero extra bytes)
onboardingIllustration.verifiedIn: Chrome (light + dark, EN + Hebrew/RTL) via a local static server, see release notes
